features.title: Collection trail using existing egg bonuses
features.rationale: Make existing collection progress and next action visible without adding economy.
features.adaptation: Show normal-pet sets and missing species in Journey; suggest an unlocked incomplete egg and open its existing shop. Existing server index and bonus remain authoritative.
build: Pure read-only goal selector using Config and existing unlock rules.
Journey set rows and target egg button; no claims, new rewards or save fields.
automated_checks: Deterministic normal/variant, completion, unlock and no-mutation tests pass.
Luau suite, Selene, StyLua and separate Rojo build pass.
engine_checks: Inspect Journey scrolling and target shop on mobile and desktop with a temporary profile.
